name: Denying God
overview: Scripture reveals that denying God stems from a heart that is deceitful and wicked, as seen in Psalms 14:1 where the fool declares there is no God, leading to corruption and evil deeds. Jeremiah emphasizes that God alone searches and judges the heart according to its true nature and actions. Jesus teaches the critical choice between serving God or worldly wealth, warning that one cannot serve both. Furthermore, He clearly states the eternal consequence of denying Him before others, promising to deny such individuals before the Father in heaven, underscoring the necessity of openly confessing faith in Christ.
